Prior predictive check of MFO_bayes()

Source: R/MFO_bayes.R
MFO_prior_check.Rd

Samples the priors of [MFO_bayes()] only (`sample_prior = "only"` in brms) and shows the fat oxidation curves they imply, with the observed steps for reference, and the prior distribution of MFO, Fatmax and Fatmin. Use it to check that the priors allow every plausible curve and few absurd ones before fitting, and, against an [MFO_bayes()] result, to see which parameters the data inform (compare the prior and posterior of d).

Usage

MFO_prior_check(
  MFO_data,
  model = c("SIN", "P3"),
  priors = NULL,
  sigma = c("constant", "proportional"),
  fatmin_prior = c(90, 14),
  ndraws = 200,
  seed = NULL,
  backend = "rstan",
  ...
)

Arguments

MFO_data

the `MFO_db` of an [MFO()] result (columns `porc_VO2` and `FAT`); every row is used, as in [MFO_kinetics()].

model

`"SIN"` (default) or `"P3"`.

priors

optional `brmsprior` object replacing all default priors.

sigma

`"constant"` (default) or `"proportional"` to intensity.

fatmin_prior

mean and SD of the normal prior of Fatmin, truncated to (Fatmax, 100) (default `c(90, 14)`, SIN only).

ndraws

number of prior curves drawn (default 200).

seed

optional integer passed to Stan.

backend

passed to [brms::brm()] (default `"rstan"`).

...

further arguments to [brms::brm()].

Value

An object of class `MFO_prior_check`: a list with `draws` (prior draws of the parameters and derived quantities), `summary` (quantiles 5, 50 and 95 %), `curves` (ndraws curves on 0-100 % VO₂max), `data` and `model`. `plot()` draws the curves.

See also

[MFO_bayes()]
